<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(tag):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    beam=None
    cells=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('w','g') and 14<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=40:
            for p in n['boundary']:
                if 16<=p[1]<=48: cells.append((p[0],p[1]))
    if cells:
        rows=[c[0] for c in cells]; cols=[c[1] for c in cells]
        beam=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    tg={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][1]>=40:
            tg[n['color']]=(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][-1][0])
    M=[ (n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][-1][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    print(tag,"beam",beam,"P",M,"targets",tg)
snap("before")
r=action(['DOWN'])
print("DOWN result", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over')})
snap("after DOWN")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(tag):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    beam=None
    cells=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('w','g') and 14<=n['boundary'][0][0]<=40:
            for p in n['boundary']:
                if 16<=p[1]<=48: cells.append((p[0],p[1]))
    if cells:
        rows=[c[0] for c in cells]; cols=[c[1] for c in cells]
        beam=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    tg={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][1]>=40:
            tg[n['color']]=(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][-1][0])
    M=[ (n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][-1][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='M' and n['boundary'][0][0]<50]
    print(tag,"beam",beam,"P",M,"targets",tg)
snap("before")
r=action(['DOWN'])
